title: Can you feel him trying to make a whore of me what he never will he ought to give it up now at this age of his life simply ruination for any woman and no satisfaction in it pretending to like it till he comes and then finish it off myself
html_source: This passage illustrates how Molly is shown to be promiscuous, but Bloom is equally so due to his sexual proclivities. One can notice this in the “Nausicaa” chapter, where Bloom is caught masturbating in front of Gerty—he openly commits a sexual act, but he receives no particular attention from it aside from it being mentioned. Molly sex life, on the other hand, is repeatedly brought up throughout the story, often in the context of how inappropriate it is. With that in mind, this passage highlights a double-standard between the two characters; Molly is shamed for her sexual desires, whereas Bloom is glanced over for his.
